policies.text: A medical device meeting baseline quality standards achieves tier-one safety status if its annual critical safety incidents do not exceed 0.
Hospital purchasing approval is granted for a device with premier safety standing that maintains liability insurance coverage of at least 5000000 USD.
Municipal water filtration compliance requires a filter to possess a NSF/ANSI Standard 53 credential.
Rebate eligibility for high efficiency is awarded to a charger with an energy efficiency rating of at least 90 percent.
Commercial lighting fixtures receive utility tariff discounts when their power factor exceeds 0.95.
Baseline quality compliance is granted to a medical device holding either a valid ISO 13485 credential or an active CE mark credential.
Industrial protective helmets receive severe-impact clearance if they pass a drop test threshold of 100 joules.
Green building tax credits apply to insulation demonstrating a thermal resistance value of at least 30 R-value.
